about: coverage-gate: a Clover report's project line coverage against a threshold; an unreadable or empty report is NOT_RUN, never a pass. Targets are the synthetic-report checks: the real-PHPUnit case needs vendor/ and a coverage driver, which the runner's plain copy has not, so it SKIPs there. Run: mutate-on-target.py TREE coverage-gate.py tests/test_coverage_gate.py tests/mutants/jpt-coverage-gate.json

mutants.name: a file's metrics read, not the project's
a report with no statements passes
edits: raise UnreadableError(f"{report} has no statements counted; refusing to call that covered")

mutants.name: an unreadable report reads as under the threshold
